title: CP-08 scan producer to CP-07 writer request
description: Exact local V1 commit-scan payload. The expected run and state revision are separate command arguments, not payload fields.
x-invariants: report equals checkpoint.last_report and their run_id, mode and policy_version values agree.

The separate expected run CLI argument equals report.run_id and checkpoint.run_id. The separate expected revision CLI argument equals checkpoint.expected_state_revision; checkpoint.committed_state_revision is exactly expected plus one.
CP-07 validates and commits state and the private checkpoint while holding its single-writer lock. This payload is not canonical state, model context or renderer input.
